repairs.quote: Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for 6 seconds. Ally champions nearby gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Range and restore (70/90/110/130/150 + (15% Ability Power)) Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every 3 seconds. Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
